tasks.notes: Yes: Thursday 10:30 is inside the Tuesday to Thursday, 09:00 to 15:00 window.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d

tasks.notes: Yes: a leaked key is rotated at once, any day and hour, once security on-call has been told.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: After an emergency rotation following a key leak, the engineer writes in the ticket the time the old certificate was revoked and the time the last node was reloaded. Is that record complete?
tasks.notes: No: the time the engineer learned of the leak is also required.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: Thirty hours after the partners hostname was rotated, a carrier partner reports TLS handshake failures. The carrier integrations team looks into it and asks the platform engineer to roll back. May the engineer roll back?
tasks.notes: Yes: rollback is not done unless the carrier integrations team asks, and here they ask.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: Summarise how an emergency rotation after a suspected key leak differs from a routine rotation.

rubric.text: It happens at once, any day and any hour, and the security on-call is told before starting.
The old certificate is revoked first, then the new one is issued and rolled out; the short outage (usually 10 to 20 minutes) is accepted.
The change board is told afterwards, not asked before.
Three nodes may be reloaded at a time instead of two, but only between 22:00 and 06:00 Rotterdam time; during the day the two node limit still applies.
The ticket records the time the leak was learned of, the time of revocation and the time the last node was reloaded.

tasks.notes: Cross-section: When to rotate, Procedure and Emergency rotation.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: Explain what the rotation bot may do on its own when running this runbook, and where it must stop or hand over to a person.

rubric.text: It runs issuing, storing and reloading (steps 1 to 3) only for hostnames in the inventory table.
It never rotates internal-api, which always needs a person to request the certificate.
If the health check fails on any node (handshake errors over 0.5%), it stops and pages the platform engineer on rotation duty and does not try a second rollback on its own.
It never runs gwctl cert purge.
